Saif Ali Khan discusses teaching sons about religion

Actor Saif Ali Khan has shared his approach to teaching his sons, Taimur and Jeh, about religion. He explained that he emphasizes the concept of one God with many names to foster an open-minded understanding of faith. This approach aims to guide his children through different religious perspectives.
